::: {#hero-heading}

Dr. Chen's research interests lie in the field of behavioural and experimental economics, with specific interests in cooperation, social preferences and prosocial behavioural. 



## Background

- 2020-2026: Ph.D. in Economics,Nottingham University Business School China, University of Nottingham Ningbo China
- 2019-2020: Assistant Research Fellow, Nottingham University Business School China, University of Nottingham Ningbo China
- 2018-2019: Data Analyst, Mars Wrigley; Associate Consultant, Kingdee Software
- 2017-2018: MSc in Business and Management, Nottingham, UK
- 2015: Exchange, Soochow University, Taiwan, China, majoring in economics
- 2013-2017: Bachelor of Management, Yantai University, China, majoring in public administration and minoring in law

:::
